sufficient_basis: Long representative sampled idle residency with stable allocation, fresh healthy/idle matching identity, one small bounded cached-head workload consumes about1GiB of8.7GiB free leaving about7.7GiB; fresh qualification and own-only exit upon any observed resident activation/memory growth protects its resumption. This is a finite controlled job, not a claim of no possible future burst.
control: Before every launch repeat three identity/health/idle/memory samples; during job inspect resident CPU ticks, pmon numeric activity, foreign PID/memory changes, free headroom, own total FB/RSS and health. N/A retained unknown. Any resident CPU activity/new foreign/identity/query uncertainty triggers immediate own-only termination.
limitations: Monitor has sample/command latency; not a hard GPU partition
No resident latency/throughput metric is available; observed idle/no activation and reserve constitute current judgment, not absolute zero-impact proof
